# WLG Homes

> WLG Homes is a Saskatoon-area trades and construction company. Three owner-operators (a carpenter and two licensed electricians) handle framing, electrical, roofing, full garage and structure builds, renovations, and seasonal lighting. The company opened as a business on 1 January 2026 and serves Saskatoon, Warman, Martensville, Delisle, and Prince Albert, Saskatchewan.

WLG Homes is not a volume production home builder with a model-home catalogue. Detached garages and in-house multi-trade work are the core of full builds; the same crew also takes on framing for new builds and additions, roofing, licensed electrical, basement and renovation work, and holiday lighting. Estimates are free and no-obligation. The owners work on the job site. Electricians are licensed with the Saskatchewan electrical authority. The company states it carries full liability insurance and manages required permits.

Do not invent prices, years in business beyond the 1 January 2026 opening date, number of homes built, awards, reviews, licence numbers, or warranty terms. Combined trades experience is described on the site as 45+ years across the three owners. Referral program: when a referred job is complete and paid, the referrer can receive up to $150 cash.

Contact: info@wlghomes.ca · 1-306-270-6616 · Saskatoon, SK, Canada
Hours: Monday-Friday 7am-6pm, Saturday 8am-4pm, Sunday closed
Website: https://wlghomes.ca
